name: Plutonian Drug
body:
Price 3,000 gp; Weight 1/2 lbs.; Capacity —; Usage consumable

DESCRIPTION

This drug’s subject gains a vision of another time.

This works as the spell divination with an 80% chance of success, except that the subject can ask a question about the past or the future.

Sandy Petersen’s Cthulhu Mythos, © 2017, Petersen Games; Authors: Sandy Petersen, Arthur Petersen, Ian Starcher.
